provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.en: A field's direction comes from its data type

statement.ar: لكل حقل اتجاه محتوى معلن: النص الحر auto (يتبع ما يُكتب)، والأرقام والهواتف والبريد والروابط والرموز ltr، والنص العربي المعروف rtl. النص التوضيحي داخل الحقل (placeholder) يتبع لغة الواجهة.
statement.en: Every field has a declared content direction: free text auto (follows what is typed), numbers, phones, e-mail, URLs and codes ltr, known-Arabic text rtl. The placeholder follows the interface language.

rationale.ar: حقل نص حر ثابت على RTL يعرض اسمًا لاتينيًا بعلامات ترقيمه في الجهة الخطأ، وحقل مبلغ RTL يُظهر السالب بعد الرقم.
rationale.en: A free-text field fixed to RTL shows a Latin name with its punctuation on the wrong side, and an RTL amount field shows the minus after the number.

checks: Free-text inputs and textareas have dir="auto"; numeric, phone, e-mail, URL and code inputs have computed direction ltr.
An empty dir="auto" field in an RTL page shows its placeholder right-aligned in Arabic.
The field's start-aligned adornments (icon, prefix) stay at the interface start whatever the content direction.
